text.BHSA 1CH 15:19: וְהַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים הֵימָ֥ן אָסָ֖ף וְאֵיתָ֑ן בִּמְצִלְתַּ֥יִם נְחֹ֖שֶׁת לְהַשְׁמִֽיעַ׃
text.KJV 1CH 15:19: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;
text.BHSA 1CH 15:20: וּזְכַרְיָ֨ה וַעֲזִיאֵ֜ל וּשְׁמִֽירָמֹ֤ות וִֽיחִיאֵל֙ וְעֻנִּ֣י וֶֽאֱלִיאָ֔ב וּמַעֲשֵׂיָ֖הוּ וּבְנָיָ֑הוּ בִּנְבָלִ֖ים עַל־עֲלָמֹֽות׃
text.KJV 1CH 15:20: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;
text.BHSA 1CH 15:21: וּמַתִּתְיָ֣הוּ וֶאֱלִֽיפְלֵ֗הוּ וּמִקְנֵיָ֨הוּ֙ וְעֹבֵ֣ד אֱדֹ֔ם וִֽיעִיאֵ֖ל וַעֲזַזְיָ֑הוּ בְּכִנֹּרֹ֥ות עַל־הַשְּׁמִינִ֖ית לְנַצֵּֽחַ׃
text.KJV 1CH 15:21: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.

A.name: Benaiah
A.line: a Levite of the second degree who played the psaltery before the ark (1CH 15:18, 15:20, 16:5)
family: descendant-of levi (Levi, third-born son of Jacob (GEN 29:34), son of Leah)

B.name: Benaiah
B.line: Levite of second degree who played the psaltery on Alamoth before the ark

why: The Hebrew places Benaiah among those playing psalteries on Alamoth, matching A’s stated role. B describes the same role, however, so the verse does not distinguish the two records or establish that two Benaiahs are named.
